mike_sales: Heads-up — SIG Q 3.2/3.3 asks who owns KMS key rotation and where evidence lives. Customer (NovaBank) flagged as blocker for POC. Need authoritative artifact.
anya_security: @mike_sales ownership is Security for policy, but Ops runs rotation. We'll provide SOC-validated artifact + rotation logs. ETA EOD tomorrow.
tom_engineer: linking artifact: https://redwood-artifacts.s3.amazonaws.com/security/kms_rotation_policy_v2.pdf (internal). Also IAM role that performs rotation: redwood-kms-rotator
tom_engineer: snippet of rotation event (sanitized):
```json
{"event":"RotateKey","keyId":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/xxxx","actor":"redwood-kms-rotator","time":"2024-06-20T18:23:11Z"}
```
jordan_sales: Great. Customer wants statement: "keys are rotated every 90 days and we keep rotation logs for 365 days." Can we confirm retention and rotation cadence?
anya_security: Confirmed — rotation cadence 90 days, retention 365 days. We can supply signed attestation (pdf) and a redacted sample log.
mike_sales: Any risk of exposing PII in logs?
tom_engineer: Logs are pre-filtered; we redact principal ARNs and IPs for external uploads. See process in docs: /security/log-redaction.md (internal).
sec-bot: [automated] Checklist updated: SIG Q3.2 evidence uploaded to /shared/sig/nova_kms. Status -> evidence_uploaded :white_check_mark:
jordan_sales: Can we bundle artifacts into a single zip for submission and include a short cover note? I can draft note.
anya_security: Yes. I'll produce attestation + redacted log & pointer to policy. @tom_engineer please create the zip and put in /shared/sig/nova_kms by EOD.
tom_engineer: Will do. Plan to include: kms_rotation_policy_v2.pdf, rotation_attestation_2024-06-20.pdf, rotation_log_sample_redacted.txt, ingress_procedure.md
mike_sales: FYI pricing/POC timeline unaffected but customer said this is gating contract signature. Let's keep cadence.
jordan_sales: I'll schedule a quick 15-min call with NovaBank on Tuesday to walk through artifacts.
anya_security: Thanks team. If we need exec sign-off I'll loop in dana_ciso.
mike_sales: Perfect. Closing loop here — will update thread when zip is live. :thumbsup:
